test_title: PYST 19: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: JKL is related to KMO in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, PQR is related to QSU. To which of the following is XYZ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern is a consistent alphabetical shift for each letter position: **+1, +2, +3**.

**For 'JKL' related to 'KMO':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a7a505eb30bf0197d9c9a772f30134351302812637bdb655d04356fd41c7943.png] 

**For 'PQR' related to 'QSU':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1b78d363ede315bd2fed1270fdbb172569ba0cf57158eab34ae52bf1422dc82.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **+1, +2, +3**.

**Applying the same logic to 'XYZ':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26b87a2eae40eb796a1c29960edb59a35ff203e62ae71196e598fbe1ed41db18.png] 

Thus, 'XYZ' is related to **YAC**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
